meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: NFSA: hides newsletter box, notices and the autoplay hero video, blurs or hides story pictures, can hide carousels and footer image
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome with a desktop UA on https://www.nfsa.gov.au/. The iPhone-UA fetch returned a Cloudflare "Just a moment" challenge page, so no phone capture exists; the site is one responsive Next.js (Tailwind) app, so the rules are expected to apply on phones (INFERRED, not seen).

- **Newsletter box**: `form.newsletter-form` 1 and `aside[data-notification="true"]` 1 (the notice bar sits inert and off-screen until the site shows a message) (LIVE).
- **Hero video**: `article[data-tracking-component="hero story tile"] video` 1 (LIVE).
- **Pictures**: `[data-tracking-component="story tile"] img` 82 and `picture` plus the collection cards (LIVE). The hero tile's video is blurred or hidden with them.
- **Carousels** `div[data-tracking-component="carousel"]` 9, **collection cards** 6, **footer feature picture** `#footer-image` 1 (LIVE).

Not verified: story, collection-item and search pages, the cart and "Your Stuff" drawers (they are `role="dialog"` panels, never touched), a login, the cookie banner (none rendered). Tailwind utility classes (`flex`, `relative`, ...) are not used; selectors rely on `data-tracking-component`, `data-notification`, ids and the form class `newsletter-form`. These tracking attributes are analytics hooks and could change without notice.
